author: CJ666
quote:
30 FPS in 2026!!!!! The sheer number of technical issues and glitches is insane. If this were Cyberpunk, people would have absolutely torn it apart.

The animations are painfully slow, even slower than RDR2. Compared to this, Arthur is literally The Flash.

The first 5 hours feel like a satisfying girlfriend simulator, and the overall story is horribly written. If you thought GTA 5 had bad writing, oh boy! At least GTA 5 was funny. In GTA 6, there's not a single good joke or even one funny character.

The only good things about the game are the visuals and the driving. But in 2026, there are a thousand games that look great, so that's nothing special.
